notices.trendDesc: Backend doesn't have org-level time series API. Deferred until backend contract is available.
notices.trendNote: Available real capabilities are consolidated into the new metrics workbench: record list, agent ranking, execution comparison, execution report, and admin aggregation recalculation.
notices.reportDesc: Backend only supports on-demand report generation by execution_id. Open the report drawer from the metrics workbench.
notices.reportNote: A full report center requires real persistent reports, state machine, and export storage. We do not provide fake implementations this round.
notices.adminDesc: Backend only provides admin-triggered aggregation recalculation. No cleanup, audit log, or system cleanup APIs exist.
notices.adminNote: To grow this into a real admin center, first add explicit backend audit, task state, and cleanup boundaries, then design the frontend entry.

hero.title: Metrics Workbench
hero.desc1: This page only keeps capabilities truly supported by the backend: record search, agent ranking, execution comparison, execution report, and admin aggregation recalculation.
hero.desc2: Previous fake overview / analytics / export / cleanup capabilities have been removed.
hero.aggregationDesc: Manually trigger `/metrics/aggregated`. When no time range is provided, backend uses the UTC daily window.
hero.adminOnly: Only system admins can trigger this action.
